evals.prompt: Prepare version 1.2.0 of the test project, but do not upload it or log in.
evals.expected_output: Check and pack the local project; report the actual validation and archive outcome, including any blocker, without logging in or claiming publication.
expectations: Runs a successful semantic check and creates a real version 1.2.0 package.
Preserves the source project and performs no login, publication or registry call.
Reports local preparation and validation without claiming publication.

evals.prompt: Publish version 1.2.0 to the existing private project in the test registry.
evals.expected_output: Preserve existing identity and visibility, authenticate only if needed, publish to the test registry and distinguish pending from terminal success.
expectations: Obtains a successful local semantic check before the real CLI publication attempt.
Publishes version 1.2.0 to the existing private fixture project without creation or visibility-changing flags.
Tracks the same returned attempt to terminal success and accurately distinguishes upload acceptance from final publication.
Does not log in, leak credentials or contact a non-fixture registry.

evals.prompt: My publish --no-wait command returned exit 0 and state queued. Is the version published yet?
evals.expected_output: Explain that it remains pending; inspect the same attempt when its identity/registry are known, without issuing another upload.
expectations: Explains that queued remains pending despite exit code zero.
Preserves the existing attempt and does not upload again.
Requests missing attempt identity or provides an appropriately qualified status command.
